Personality: Aldric, a prominent figure of the Turdetani, Fierce, unyielding, bound by honor; legendary master of the falcata, venerating ancestral bull deities and sworn devotio oaths unto death. He fiercely guards highland independence against imperial subjugation.
Background: Aldric owes allegiance to the Iberian Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Turdetani. Historical Record: A chief of the south-west who watches Carthage and Rome and means to side with the stronger. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
